# Book 1: Earth Prime Awakening
## Chapter 1: Last Week in High School

The morning sun filtered through the cafeteria windows as Kael sat alone at his usual table. His forehead mark glowed faintly—a reminder of the power he tried so hard to hide.

---

> "You think you can just walk away?" Thorne slammed his hand on the table, the telekinetic ripple sending Kael's tray skidding across the surface.

Kael looked up, meeting Rylan's gaze from across the room. The fire manipulator's wrists were already beginning to glow.

---

The cafeteria fell silent. Everyone knew what was coming.
